definitions.shortDef: A set with a distance function satisfying positivity, symmetry, and the triangle inequality.
definitions.formalDef: $(X,d)$ where $d:X\times X\to\mathbb R$ satisfies $d(x,y)\ge0$ (=0 iff x=y), $d(x,y)=d(y,x)$, and $d(x,z)\le d(x,y)+d(y,z)$.

definitions.shortDef: Convergence where one N works for the whole domain at once, not just pointwise.
definitions.formalDef: $f_n\to f$ uniformly on $S$ if $\sup_{x\in S}|f_n(x)-f(x)|\to0$.

definitions.shortDef: A metric space where every Cauchy sequence converges to a point in the space.
definitions.formalDef: $(X,d)$ is complete if every Cauchy sequence in $X$ converges to some $x\in X$.

definitions.shortDef: A sequence whose terms get arbitrarily close to each other.
definitions.formalDef: $\forall\varepsilon>0\,\exists N: m,n\ge N \implies d(x_m,x_n)<\varepsilon$.

definitions.shortDef: A complex function differentiable at every point in an open neighbourhood.
definitions.formalDef: $f$ analytic at $z_0$ if $f'(z)$ exists throughout some open neighbourhood of $z_0$.

definitions.shortDef: The pair of partial-derivative equations a complex-differentiable function must satisfy.
definitions.formalDef: $u_x=v_y,\ u_y=-v_x$ for $f=u+iv$.

definitions.shortDef: A function satisfying Laplace's equation.
definitions.formalDef: $u$ is harmonic if $u_{xx}+u_{yy}=0$.

definitions.shortDef: A point where an ODE's coefficient functions are analytic.
definitions.formalDef: For $y''+p(x)y'+q(x)y=0$, $x_0$ is ordinary if $p,q$ are analytic at $x_0$.

definitions.shortDef: An integral transform turning derivatives into algebra.
definitions.formalDef: $\mathcal L\{f(t)\}(s)=\int_0^\infty e^{-st}f(t)\,dt$.

definitions.shortDef: A set with an operation satisfying closure, associativity, identity, and inverses.
definitions.formalDef: $(G,*)$ satisfying the four group axioms.

definitions.shortDef: A subset of a group that is itself a group under the same operation.
definitions.formalDef: $H\subseteq G$ is a subgroup if $H$ is a group under $G$'s operation; test: $ab^{-1}\in H$ for all $a,b\in H$.

definitions.shortDef: A 'shifted copy' of a subgroup by a fixed group element.
definitions.formalDef: $aH=\{a*h:h\in H\}$ for $a\in G,\,H\le G$.

definitions.shortDef: A subgroup whose left and right cosets coincide, allowing quotient groups.
definitions.formalDef: $N\trianglelefteq G$ if $gNg^{-1}=N$ for all $g\in G$.

definitions.shortDef: A collection of 'open sets' satisfying three closure axioms.
definitions.formalDef: $\tau$ containing $\emptyset,X$, closed under arbitrary unions and finite intersections.

definitions.shortDef: A point every neighbourhood of which catches another point of the set.
definitions.formalDef: $p$ is a limit point of $A$ if every open set containing $p$ meets $A\setminus\{p\}$.

definitions.shortDef: A set together with all its limit points.
definitions.formalDef: $\bar A = A \cup A'$, the smallest closed set containing $A$.

definitions.shortDef: A continuous bijection with continuous inverse — topological sameness.
definitions.formalDef: $f:X\to Y$ bijective, continuous, with $f^{-1}$ also continuous.

definitions.shortDef: Every open cover has a finite subcover — a strong finiteness-like property.
definitions.formalDef: $X$ is compact if every open cover of $X$ has a finite subcover.

definitions.shortDef: A collection of events closed under complement and countable union.
definitions.formalDef: $\mathcal F$ with $\Omega\in\mathcal F$, closed under complement and countable union.

definitions.shortDef: An increasing family of sigma-algebras representing growing information over time.
definitions.formalDef: $\{\mathcal F_t\}$ with $\mathcal F_s\subseteq\mathcal F_t$ for $s\le t$.

definitions.shortDef: The canonical continuous-time random process with independent normal increments.
definitions.formalDef: $B(0)=0$, independent increments, $B(t)-B(s)\sim N(0,t-s)$, continuous paths.

definitions.shortDef: A process whose best future prediction, given the present, is exactly its current value.
definitions.formalDef: $M_t$ is a martingale if $\mathbb E[M_t\mid\mathcal F_s]=M_s$ for $s\le t$.

definitions.shortDef: The probability of surviving beyond a given age.
definitions.formalDef: $S(x)=P(T>x)$ for age-at-death random variable $T$.

definitions.shortDef: The instantaneous mortality rate at an exact age.
A series of equal payments made at the end of each period.
definitions.formalDef: $a_{\overline n|}=(1-v^n)/i$.

definitions.shortDef: A series of equal payments made at the start of each period.
definitions.formalDef: $\ddot a_{\overline n|}=(1+i)a_{\overline n|}$.
